examples.text: The simplest method of calculating the radius of a curve in situ is to measure the versine; in railway practice this is done by extending a tape 66 ft. (1 ch.) long in a straight line or chord between two points on the periphery of a curve, and then measuring the maximum distance of the rail from the chord at the centre of the 66 ft. glosses: Convention, pacte que l’on fait pour terminer un différend.

examples.text: Le Quai d’Orsay n'avait oublié qu'une chose : de notifier l’accord franco-britannique aux puissances signataires de la Convention de Madrid.
